scientific_question: At an output-coordinate budget exactly matched to 64 sparse Givens stages, does a fixed-FHT block-local general linear map recover useful non-orthogonal c_proj output transport, and does fitting that map in activation-output space improve cross-window task direction?

identity.execution_commit_rule: record a clean pushed commit containing this immutable plan before implementation

shared_hidden_chart.feedback: zero for this one-step prospective diagnostic
shared_hidden_chart.weight_decay_application: identical production ordering in every arm

fixed_block_basis.definition: one exact fixed signed/permuted normalized block-FHT basis and its inverse

fht_block32_affine_fro.per_block_solve: B=(X^T X + ridge I)^-1 X^T R in float64
fht_block32_affine_fro.ridge: 1e-6 times mean diagonal of X^T X
fht_block32_affine_fro.application: X_new=X+X B blockwise, then invert the fixed basis and transpose

fht_block32_affine_activation.per_block_solve: B=(A^T A + ridge I)^-1 A^T T in float64
fht_block32_affine_activation.ridge: 1e-6 times mean diagonal of A^T A
fht_block32_affine_activation.application: the same direct block-affine map as the Frobenius arm; H_holdout is scoring-only

trust_constraint.definition: For each layer-phase cell, multiply every candidate B block by min(1, sqrt(output64_control_output_delta_energy/raw_candidate_output_delta_energy)).
trust_constraint.purpose: prevent activation-metric scale amplification while never enlarging the raw affine solution
trust_constraint.invertibility_check: minimum singular value of every exact I+B block must be at least 0.95 after trust scaling

diagnostic_decomposition: Frobenius energy of skew, symmetric-off-diagonal, and diagonal parts of B
exact output-update energy and trust scale
block condition numbers and minimum singular value of I+B
fit and held-out activation-output residual energy
fit and held-out task-gradient predicted CE descent
finite-step CE on every phase and window
prohibited: fit or selection on holdout tokens
dense residual or dense optimizer update
more than 24576 output coordinates per layer
post-hoc ridge, trust, seed, or block-size tuning

candidate_common_pass_all: all outputs, linear solves, exact maps, and metrics are finite
candidate uses exactly 159744 total coordinates per selected layer, equal to frobenius_output64
candidate exact output-delta energy is no greater than frobenius_output64 in every layer-phase cell and in aggregate
minimum singular value of every exact I+B block is at least 0.95
aggregate held-out activation-output residual energy is no more than 0.95 times frobenius_output64
aggregate held-out predicted CE descent is positive, at least 1.10 times frobenius_output64, and at least 0.004353292856055148
candidate beats frobenius_output64 on all four held-out finite-step CE comparisons and at least seven of all eight comparisons
mean candidate finite-step CE is at least 0.0005 lower than frobenius_output64 and no greater than 7.180657014250755
activation_candidate_extra_pass_all: activation candidate beats the Frobenius affine candidate on at least three of four held-out finite-step CE comparisons
activation candidate mean finite-step CE is lower than the Frobenius affine candidate
selection_order: select fht_block32_affine_fro if it passes all common gates
otherwise select fht_block32_affine_activation only if it passes all common and activation-extra gates
otherwise reject the fixed-basis block-affine output family
decision_rule.pass_action: preregister only the selected production block-affine matcher, add exact-resume/correctness tests, then require an I/O-inclusive at-least-20-percent MFU gate before considering one 124M causal run
decision_rule.fail_action: reject the fixed-basis block-affine family without causal training; use the symmetric/skew decomposition to decide whether to abandon fixed-basis output maps or design a state-conditioned sparse non-orthogonal chart
